verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly's own docs describe Experimentation that measures how features affect end users on chosen metrics, and Bayesian analysis that declares a winning variation or highlights the leading one. Pricing lists 'A/B Tests and Experiments' as a product capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of multivariate (more than two variation) experiments specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of experiment results (community evidence only covers multivariate flags, not experiments).

support.subject: As a product manager, I can run A/B and multivariate experiments on flags and see which variation wins on my metrics

citations.quote: Experiments let you measure the effect of features on end users by tracking metrics your team cares about.
LaunchDarkly highlights the leading variation when there is not yet enough experiment data to declare a winning variation.
You can measure things like page views, clicks, load time, infrastructure costs, and more.
